brand.concept: AIに仕事と副業をどこまで任せると、本当にお金が生まれるのかを数字で検証する。
brand.promise: 成功談だけでなく、売上0円・失敗・コスト・人間作業時間まで公開する。
differentiation: every core article must contain first-party experiment data or a genuinely original test
publish failures when they teach something; do not manufacture success stories

whyThisDirection.market: AI/technology, SNS/content operations and side-hustle categories are growing on note, but generic AI content is already crowded.
whyThisDirection.platformFit: note explicitly prioritizes first-party experience, continuous records and original works in its recommendation philosophy.
whyThisDirection.accountAsset: The account already has a real failed automation experiment: 100+ paid note publications and dozens of free posts with weak purchase evidence. This is more distinctive than another generic how-to article.
whyThisDirection.objective: turn the existing failure and future automated experiments into an ongoing story, dataset and paid research product

editorialPillars.name: AI副業の公開実験
examples: 無料Webツールを作って売上を追う
BOOTH/アプリ/デジタル商品を自動運用して実測

editorialPillars.name: AIツールの同条件比較
examples: ChatGPT/Claude/Geminiに同じ販売課題を任せる
同じ予算・同じ時間で成果比較

editorialPillars.name: ネットの稼げる話を実際に検証
examples: 『AIだけで月1万円』を条件固定で検証
価格変更・無料導線・投稿頻度など1変数ずつ検証

prohibitedContent: AI-generated advice that has not been tested when the article is framed as a result
investment recommendations or health claims used merely because those markets have high willingness to pay

freeContent.purpose: audience growth, curiosity, trust and experiment continuity
freeContent.rule: Give the headline result for free. Do not hide the result behind the paywall.

paidContent.purpose: sell depth, evidence and reproducibility—not the headline result
required: exact prompts/rules/scripts when safe and useful
paidContent.rule: No paid article until it contains information that could not be reconstructed from a generic web search.

launchSeries.title: AIで有料noteを100本以上自動投稿した。ほとんど売れなかったので全部やり直す
launchSeries.hook: 大量生産した本人が、何が間違っていたかを公開する。

launchSeries.title: 100本以上作って分かった「AI量産noteが売れない理由」｜失敗データと自動化設計を全部公開
launchSeries.value: full postmortem, topic map, duplication examples, pricing inconsistencies, automation architecture and reset rules

launchSeries.title: 次は『量産しないAI』で30日だけやる。売上0円からの再実験ルール
launchSeries.hook: one experiment, fixed rules, all numbers published

launchSeries.title: AIに3つの副業を同時に任せたら、最初に1円を作ったのはどれだったか
launchSeries.hook: cross-channel real-money comparison; publish only after measured

launchSeries.title: AI副業30日決算｜売上・経費・人間作業時間・失敗を全部公開
launchSeries.value: full P&L, automation map, decision log, prompts/scripts and next-month plan; publish only after 30 real days of data

monetizationRoadmap.phase1: free experiment series -> one paid postmortem
monetizationRoadmap.phase2: monthly paid experiment report if the series earns repeat interest
monetizationRoadmap.phase3: membership only after multiple repeat purchasers/followers show demand; offer monthly raw data + full decision log, not generic community chatter
monetizationRoadmap.secondary: reuse original datasets and scripts in BOOTH/app products only when they provide standalone value

oldPortfolio.decision: retire almost all legacy generic know-how content
oldPortfolio.deletionTiming: stage deletion only after the first replacement launch package exists, to avoid leaving an empty profile and losing the ability to reference the old experiment.
oldPortfolio.keepRule: keep only pages that are needed as evidence for the postmortem or have meaningful engagement; otherwise retire after launch

successMetrics.rule: likes are not revenue and article count is not success
